subject: Helix Tools — API versioning & stability request
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@helixtools.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: API stability window + versioning for Helix connector

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Helix is excited about Redwood’s latency profile and the new batching optimizations. We’re finalizing our next release of the Helix CLI and embedding integration (planned GA in Q3), and we have a couple of asks around the Redwood public API / SDK:

- We need a 6-month guaranteed stability window for the text-generation HTTP contract (no breaking parameter renames or payload changes) so our shipped client doesn’t break for enterprise customers.
- If changes are required, we’d like a clear semantic versioning plan and a deprecation schedule (e.g., v1 -> v2, 90 day warning + compatibility layer).
- We’d also like a lightweight compatibility matrix for any upcoming deprecations so we can programmatically detect warnings at build time.

Attached is a short PDF outlining our proposed constraints and a compatibility matrix we’d fill out together. Can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week to align on feasibility and timeline?

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Helix Tools, Inc.

Attachment: helix-api-stability-request.pdf
Attachment: helix-compat-matrix.xlsx

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@helixtools.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: API stability window + versioning for Helix connector

Samira — thanks for the clear ask and the docs, appreciate the detail. We’re broadly aligned on the goals: predictable contracts for partners + a clear deprecation cadence. Quick notes before a sync:

- Redwood is able to commit to stability for surface-level payload schemas for GA models for a 180-day window if a pinned model version is used (we’ll document exceptions).
- We already maintain internal semver for SDK releases; the gap is how we communicate breaking changes on the public REST contract and provide fallback behavior.

Can you do next Tue 2026-05-12 10:00 PT? I’ll bring Jonas (runtime/compat) and Priyom (platform partnerships) to map the technical and commercial implications. Also, please upload a filled compat-matrix for your most common client calls (create-session, generate, embeddings) so Jonas can review prior to the call.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-proposed-versioning.md

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 11:41:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Helix request — technical assessment

Vanessa/Priyom — quick technical read on Helix’s ask (high level):

- Feasibility: We can implement a public semantic version column for the REST API and publish a compatibility matrix. We already have feature-flagguards in runtime for parameter toggles which can provide a non-breaking compatibility layer for ~3 months.
- Limitations: Model-level behavior changes (kernel selection, quantization differences) can still affect output even if the schema is stable. We should be explicit about functional compatibility vs contract stability.
- Proposal:
  1) Publish a formal API versioning doc (v1, v2 semantics) and guarantee 180 days for contract stability for any 'v' release;
  2) Introduce an explicit "compatibility-mode" header clients can set to opt into conservative runtime defaults (slightly higher latency but fewer surprises);
  3) For true breaking changes, follow a 90/60/30 communication cadence (announcement/technical migration guide/deprecation) and provide a migration helper in SDKs.

I’ll prepare a short technical appendix for Tuesday’s sync and draft examples of the compatibility-mode header behavior.

—Jonas Weber
Principal Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@helixtools.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: integrations@helixtools.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: API stability window + versioning for Helix connector

Thanks — that all sounds promising. We can make the Tue slot work; confirmed 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. I uploaded the filled compatibility matrix to the Drive folder and flagged the top three endpoints that matter for our CLI.

A couple of quick asks for the agenda:
- Sample lifecycle e-mail / deprecation notice copy we can share with our customers,
- Timeline for implementing the compatibility-mode header in the SDK and runtime,
- Agreement language for a stability guarantee we can reference in our partner contract (we’ll share a redline).

Samira

Attachment: (uploaded) helix-compat-matrix.xlsx

2) I’ll draft partner contract language for a 180-day stability window and circulate a redline by EOD Monday, 2026-05-10.

We’ll aim to follow up the sync with a joint appendix (compatibility matrix + migration plan) and a DocuSign-ready addendum to the partner MSA. Looking forward to aligning.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
